title: agentsurface launcher configuration
description: Per-user configuration for the agentsurface launcher, read from ~/.config/agentsurface/config.json (XDG_CONFIG_HOME relocates the directory). The file is optional: with no file at all, yolo is off for every harness. When the file does exist it is validated strictly and every fault is a config_invalid domain error that fails the launch — a config that would be silently misread is worse than none, because yolo opens permission gates and a typo must fail the launch rather than quietly launch gated. Only `doctor` downgrades that to a report.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, for editors that offer completion and validation. The loader accepts it and ignores it; it is the only key besides "yolo" that does not fail validation.

yolo.description: Whether a launch drops each harness's own interactive permission gates by injecting that harness's documented flag into the launch spec: --dangerously-skip-permissions for claude, --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox for codex, --approve for pi. Omit the key entirely and every harness is off. A bare boolean sets all three at once; an object sets them individually and leaves the unnamed ones off. Utility invocations never receive the flag, and a flag the caller already forwarded after `--` is not duplicated (ADR 0006). `--yolo` and `--no-yolo` override this per launch.

oneOf.description: One answer for every harness: true injects each harness's permission flag into claude, codex, and pi alike; false is the default state and injects nothing.

Per-harness answers. Only claude, codex, and pi are accepted — an unknown harness name is a config_invalid error rather than a silently ignored line, so that a misspelling can never read as "off" when the operator meant "on". Any harness left out stays off.

claude.description: Inject --dangerously-skip-permissions into claude launches. Defaults to false when omitted.

codex.description: Inject --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox into codex launches. Defaults to false when omitted.

pi.description: Inject --approve into pi launches. Defaults to false when omitted. Pi's tools never prompt, so this only auto-trusts project-local files.
